name: @afa/domain
description: Domain layer. Entities, value objects, domain services, and repository/port interfaces for the frozen PRD's financial engine (Chapter 8) and every other module chapter. Deliberately framework-agnostic: zero runtime dependencies on NestJS, Prisma, Redis, or any other package in this repository — packages/infrastructure depends on this package to implement its interfaces, never the reverse (IMPLEMENTATION-BLUEPRINT.md §2 package-boundary table; BR-SYS-002, Chapter 3 §3.21.2). Business modules are implemented in a later phase (ENGINEERING-TASK-BREAKDOWN.md Phase 4 onward) — this package is currently structural scaffolding only.
